verdict.rationale: Clara's own docs show an accounts-payable surface: the API can 'process invoices', and there is a money-moving AP payment endpoint (`POST /api/v3/accounts-payable/pix`), so AP lives in the same platform. Vendor payment is evidenced only via Pix, and the approvals mentioned are for expense reporting, not AP routing. Missing for 10: documented invoice capture/OCR detail, AP-specific approval routing, ACH, check, and wire payment rails, independent or hands-on corroboration.
